---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

library(readr)
jobs <- read_csv("jobs_in_data.csv.zip")
View(jobs)

data.lm <- lm(salary_in_usd ~ salary, data = jobs)
data.lm
summary(data.lm)

predict(data.lm, newdata = data.frame(salary = 80000))

resid(data.lm)

hist(resid(data.lm))

plot(jobs$salary,resid(data.lm), main = "Observed vs. Residuals",
     xlab = "Observed Salary", 
     ylab = "Residuals")

abline(h = 0,  col = "red", lwd = 2)
